rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an individual human being.

example.english: Every human has their own way of thinking.
example.traditional: 每個人都有自己嘅諗法。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 nam2 faat3

rows.note: Use this when referring to humans collectively as a species or to humanity.

example.english: The human species still hasn't found alien life.
example.traditional: 人類仲未搵到外星生命。
example.jyutping: jan4 leoi6 zung6 mei6 wan2 dou2 ngoi6 sing1 sang1 meng6

rows.note: Use this before a noun when referring to the human species as a whole.

example.english: The history of human beings is very long.
example.jyutping: jan4 leoi6 ge3 lik6 si2 hou2 coeng4

rows.note: Use this for a quality or reaction arising from human nature, especially when contrasting it with the divine or non-human.

example.english: This is a weakness of human nature.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 jan4 sing3 ge3 joek6 dim2

rows.note: Use this to describe someone who feels compassion for other people.

example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jau5 tung4 cing4 sam1
